name: msquic
description_en: Cross-platform, C implementation of the IETF QUIC protocol, exposed to C, C++, C# and Rust.
readme_excerpt: MsQuic is a Microsoft implementation of the IETF QUIC protocol. It is cross-platform, written in C and designed to be a general purpose QUIC library. MsQuic also has C++ API wrapper classes and exposes interop layers for both Rust and C#. > [!TIP] > You are using MsQuic? Let us know! Knowing our users lets us prioritize work and keep improving MsQuic in the best possible direction. > Post in the Discussion to say hello and give us a wave on Discord!
